From 944c614b0a7afa5b87612c3fb557b95a50ad654c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Edward Cree <ecree.xilinx@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jan 2026 16:16:34 +0000
Subject: [PATCH] sfc: fix deadlock in RSS config read

Since cited commit, core locks the net_device's rss_lock when handling
 ethtool -x command, so driver's implementation should not lock it
 again.  Remove the latter.

Fixes: 040cef30b5e6 ("net: ethtool: move get_rxfh callback under the rss_lock")
Reported-by: Damir Mansurov <damir.mansurov@oktetlabs.ru>
Closes: https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=1126015
Suggested-by: Ben Hutchings <ben@decadent.org.uk>
Signed-off-by: Edward Cree <ecree.xilinx@gmail.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260123161634.1215006-1-edward.cree@amd.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/net/ethernet/sfc/mcdi_filters.c b/drivers/net/ethernet/sfc/mcdi_filters.c
index 6ef96292909a..3db589b90b68 100644
--- a/drivers/net/ethernet/sfc/mcdi_filters.c
+++ b/drivers/net/ethernet/sfc/mcdi_filters.c
@@ -2182,12 +2182,7 @@ int efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_context_config(struct efx_nic *efx,
 
 int efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_config(struct efx_nic *efx)
 {
-	int rc;
-
-	mutex_lock(&efx->net_dev->ethtool->rss_lock);
-	rc = efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_context_config(efx, &efx->rss_context);
-	mutex_unlock(&efx->net_dev->ethtool->rss_lock);
-	return rc;
+	return efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_context_config(efx, &efx->rss_context);
 }
 
 void efx_mcdi_rx_restore_rss_contexts(struct efx_nic *efx)
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

The patch fixes a deadlock in the sfc driver's RSS configuration path by removing an unnecessary and redundant lock. The modification is contained within a single file:

- **`drivers/net/ethernet/sfc/mcdi_filters.c`**  
  In the function `efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_config`, two lines were removed:
  - `mutex_lock(&efx->net_dev->ethtool->rss_lock);`
  - `mutex_unlock(&efx->net_dev->ethtool->rss_lock);`

  The function now directly calls `efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_context_config(efx, &efx->rss_context)` and returns its result, without acquiring the lock itself.

## Relationships Between Changes

- The removed lock/unlock pair was the direct cause of the deadlock: the core network stack (via the `ethtool` `get_rxfh` handler) already holds the `rss_lock` before calling into the driver's implementation. The driver's attempt to acquire the same lock again resulted in a self-deadlock.
- The fix eliminates the driver's lock acquisition, aligning it with the locking assumption established by commit `040cef30b5e6` ("net: ethtool: move get_rxfh callback under the rss_lock").
- No other files were modified; the change is localized to the single lock/unlock removal in the sfc driver.

Here is the commit message:
sfc: fix deadlock in RSS config read

Since cited commit, core locks the net_device's rss_lock when handling
 ethtool -x command, so driver's implementation should not lock it
 again.  Remove the latter.

Fixes: 040cef30b5e6 ("net: ethtool: move get_rxfh callback under the rss_lock")
Reported-by: Damir Mansurov <damir.mansurov@oktetlabs.ru>
Closes: https://bugs.debian.org/cgi-bin/bugreport.cgi?bug=1126015
Suggested-by: Ben Hutchings <ben@decadent.org.uk>
Signed-off-by: Edward Cree <ecree.xilinx@gmail.com>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260123161634.1215006-1-edward.cree@amd.com
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The driver's efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_config function acquired the rss_lock mutex, but the core ethtool handler (since commit 040cef30b5e6) already holds that lock when invoking the driver's RSS read callback. This double locking of a non-reentrant mutex caused a deadlock.

Here is the patch:
 
 int efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_config(struct efx_nic *efx)
 {
-	int rc;
-
-	mutex_lock(&efx->net_dev->ethtool->rss_lock);
-	rc = efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_context_config(efx, &efx->rss_context);
-	mutex_unlock(&efx->net_dev->ethtool->rss_lock);
-	return rc;
+	return efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_context_config(efx, &efx->rss_context);
 }

Root cause:
The driver's efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_config function acquired the rss_lock mutex, but the core ethtool handler (since commit 040cef30b5e6) already holds that lock when invoking the driver's RSS read callback. This double locking of a non-reentrant mutex caused a deadlock.

Code statements information:
The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
mutex_lock(&efx->net_dev->ethtool->rss_lock);
rc = efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_context_config(efx, &efx->rss_context);
mutex_unlock(&efx->net_dev->ethtool->rss_lock);
```
Reason:  
The core ethtool handler (`get_rxfh` callback) already holds the `rss_lock` mutex before calling the driver's RSS read function. By also acquiring the same non-reentrant mutex inside `efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_config`, the driver attempts a double lock, causing a deadlock.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
int efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_config(struct efx_nic *efx)
{
	return efx_mcdi_rx_pull_rss_context_config(efx, &efx->rss_context);
}
```
Reason:  
The fix removes the redundant mutex lock/unlock calls because the caller (core ethtool code) already guarantees the lock is held. This resolves the deadlock by leaving the lock acquisition to the caller, which is the appropriate design since commit 040cef30b5e6.
